metadata.title: When didactics meet data science: process data analysis in large‑scale mathematics assessment in France

design_fields.q1_rationale: The study focuses on item-level correctness rather than using plausible values for cognitive achievement scales.
design_fields.q2_rationale: Recorded evidence does not explicitly establish an unweighted analysis. Original extraction rationale: The study explicitly states that it does not report the use of complex survey weights.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study analyzes log data rather than student-level survey data where schools are the sampling unit.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study mentions internal validation methods such as supervised learning and clustering but does not validate findings on external datasets.
